title: Figure 3.2: Jet Operational Mode in Experimental IEC Device and Jet Set-up
description: Panel (a) is a color photograph looking into a spherical IEC chamber glowing red, with a bright plasma jet streaming out to the left from the central grid. Panel (b) is a schematic of the jet set-up showing the accelerating grid, xenon feed, insulator, electron emitters, electron guide, a -1 kV supply and +100 V bias, with the 'Plasma Jet' exiting through an enlarged grid opening.
